meta.source: Figma file [private], page StyleElements (0:1), section Skill (633:3). Extracted 2026-07-23 via Figma MCP (get_variable_defs + get_metadata + get_design_context). VERIFY items resolved against reference renders 2026-07-23.
meta.source_of_truth: Figma VARIABLES + measured frame geometry + reference renders (assets/figma-refs/). Hex labels and sizes printed on the Rules01-Rules03 slides are partially outdated - never use them as data.

canvas.note: The 1920x1080 px design canvas maps onto the standard PowerPoint 16:9 slide of 960x540 pt (13.333x7.5 in). Convert any px value to pt by multiplying by 0.5. (Do NOT use dpi-based 0.75: at 96 dpi 1920px would be a 20in slide, which is wrong - the slide size is fixed at 13.333in.)

meta.font_embedding: Not required - Arial is system-native everywhere.

Main-Navy.role: declared in Figma variables as heading color, but NOT observed in canonical renders - headings on light use Graphite

Graphite.role: section background, dark/main tone of headings and two-tone titles, gradient top

High.role: PRIMARY ACCENT - accent words/lines in two-tone headings, first chart series

Gray-Dark.role: muted text, muted part of two-tone headings, gradient bottom, agenda separators

White-Cool.role: image placeholder fill, light heading tone on Navy background

typography.note: Regular is the ONLY weight in the system. No bold, no italic.
typography.tracking_note: -1% letter-spacing on ALL text. In DrawingML rPr@spc (units of 1/100 pt): spc = -round(font_size_pt), e.g. 26px -> 13pt -> spc=-13.

grid.bottom_boundary_note: Bottom grid boundary set by the client's PowerPoint guide readout (2026-08-06): dragged to where the guide reads 8.00 cm below slide center, i.e. y=993.5px (bottom = 270pt center + 8cm = 496.77pt). Content height is 943.5 (=993.5-50); raised ~36.5px from the old 1030. (An earlier 892/y=942 overshot too high.) Top/left/right margins stay 50px; bottom margin is 86.5px. Footer UNCHANGED, sits below the grid in the bottom band: caption (52,1033), pagination (y~1048).

columns.note: Rules06 states 135px but 12*135+11*20=1840 > 1820. Engine computes: col_width = (1820 - 11*20)/12 = 133.33px. Canonical templates use MEASURED coordinates, the grid is for composing new layouts.

rows.note: 26 rows fit the content height (943.5px, bottom boundary at y=993.5 = 8.00cm below center). Engine computes: row_height = (943.5 - 25*14)/26 = 22.83px. (Was 24.23px over the old 980px height.)

caption.color: context-dependent (Gray-Dark on light, lighter on dark)

footer.applies_to: slides 04 and 06-15. NO footer on 02, 03, 05 (verified against reference renders). Cover (01): caption only at (50,1016), no pagination.

effects.shadows: none - the system is strictly flat

image_placeholders.note: Sharp corners - resolved by pixel check of all placeholders, 2026-07-23.

known_discrepancies: H1 size: variable=64px, Rules03 label=60px, actual cover render=72px. Token=64; template 01 uses a measured 72px override (see layouts.md).
Caption line-height: variable=100%, Rules03 label=110%. Token=100%.
Rules01 hex labels differ from variables: Navy #081E45 vs #071A3C; Gray-Dark #A0A5B1 vs #A8B1C7; Grey-Light #D9D9D9 vs #CCD1DB.
Rules02: High-4 labelled #D1EBFA, variable is #E9F5FC; third and fourth swatches both captioned 'High-3' on the slide.
Grid arithmetic in Rules06 does not close (see grid.columns.note / grid.rows.note).

R5 (H1 for 2-4 words / H2 for 5+) is violated by the canonical file itself: section statements 03-05 and headings on 14/15 render multi-word titles at 64px H1. Canonical reproductions follow the renders (layouts.md); NEW slides must follow R5.
Main-Navy #051736 exists as a variable but no canonical render uses it - headings on light backgrounds are Graphite #454E63.
Slide 10 lists a 190x38 logo frame in metadata but the reference render shows it empty - no logo shape is emitted.
